LanguageData.MAP_Theme_AbundantBlessings.label: Abundant blessings
LanguageData.MAP_Theme_AbundantBlessings.description: A rare run of good fortune is quietly gathering. Aid, opportunities, and unexpected gifts will arrive in succession, and positive events will occur more frequently than usual.
LanguageData.MAP_Theme_CausalDisturbance.label: Causal disturbance
LanguageData.MAP_Theme_CausalDisturbance.description: A simulation of causal relationships. Event probabilities increase greatly, and all events occur with equal probability. When one event occurs, another is triggered at the same time.
LanguageData.MAP_Theme_CelestialDisorder.label: Celestial disorder
LanguageData.MAP_Theme_CelestialDisorder.description: The atmosphere and weather are gradually departing from their usual patterns. Extreme weather and environmental anomalies become more frequent, while the chances of other events decrease.
LanguageData.MAP_Theme_DisplacedPeople.label: Displaced people
LanguageData.MAP_Theme_DisplacedPeople.description: Environmental changes leave some survivors homeless and cause some factions to raid more often. Other events become less frequent.
LanguageData.MAP_Theme_Encirclement.label: Encirclement
LanguageData.MAP_Theme_Encirclement.description: Hostility from every direction is converging on the colony. Different enemies will attack in different ways, one after another. When one assault ends, the next may already be close at hand.
LanguageData.MAP_Theme_GreatSilence.label: Great silence
LanguageData.MAP_Theme_GreatSilence.description: The world has never been so quiet. For a time, no random events will occur.
LanguageData.MAP_Theme_IllFortune.label: Ill fortune
LanguageData.MAP_Theme_IllFortune.description: Crows call in the distance, black cats dart through shadows, and ominous signs appear one after another. For a time, small troubles will arise frequently and good fortune will not arrive. Fortunately, major troubles will become less common.
LanguageData.MAP_Theme_InsectUnrest.label: Insect unrest
LanguageData.MAP_Theme_InsectUnrest.description: Faint tremors rise from underground as insects search for new hives. Insect-related events become more likely.
LanguageData.MAP_Theme_MechanicalEcho.label: Mechanical echo
LanguageData.MAP_Theme_MechanicalEcho.description: Distant mechanical signals are gathering as dormant war machines answer one another's calls. Mechanoid-related events become more likely.
LanguageData.MAP_Theme_OrderInversion.label: Order inversion
LanguageData.MAP_Theme_OrderInversion.description: The established order is quietly reversing. Rare events emerge while ordinary occurrences fall silent. Events become more frequent; the rarer an event was originally, the more likely it becomes, while common events are suppressed.
LanguageData.MAP_Theme_SimulationBeginning.label: Simulation beginning
LanguageData.MAP_Theme_SimulationBeginning.descriptio: A new simulation cycle has just begun. The Wheel of Fate is simulating the colony's changes in a relatively stable environment. Positive events become more likely, while negative events become less likely.
LanguageData.MAP_Theme_TradeSeason.label: Trade season
LanguageData.MAP_Theme_TradeSeason.description: Trade routes grow busier, with surface and orbital exchanges bringing new opportunities to the colony. Trading becomes more common, while negative events become significantly less frequent.
LanguageData.MAP_Theme_TravelFever.label: Travel fever
LanguageData.MAP_Theme_TravelFever.description: An invisible restlessness spreads along roads, through wilderness, and across the sky. Herds begin migrating, travelers take to the roads, and even long journeys no longer seem as difficult as before.
LanguageData.MAP_Theme_VoidCalling.label: Void calling
LanguageData.MAP_Theme_VoidCalling.description: Whispers from the void sound in your ears. Something is coming.
LanguageData.MAP_Theme_WildPulse.label: Wild pulse
LanguageData.MAP_Theme_WildPulse.description: The wilderness is full of vigorous, unpredictable life. Animals become easier to tame, and more animals wander here, both friendly and maddened.
